correctness.rationale: The statement quantifies over all finite thick GQs without transitivity assumptions. A complete 10-type distance-pair extension table is algebraically derived from line degree s+1, point degree t+1, collinear-pair common-neighbor number s-1 and noncollinear-pair number t+1; LL and LP cases follow by duality. For all s,t>=2 every listed entry is positive, including t(s²-s+1)-s>(0), and all omitted entries zero, so extension supports match independently of parameters. The three-pebble invariant preserves side and distance on at most two fixed anchors after moving a pebble, and the table ensures a matching extension at every game round. A 4-variable sentence demanding four pairwise D2-distinct points tests line size >=4 and separates s=2 from s=3. Formula |V|=(s+t+2)(st+1) gives minimal 30 at (2,2). Independently checked row totals and positivity for every 2<=s,t<=33; finite checks corroborate the uniform symbolic proof, not replace it.
